messages.content: You are a helpful customer support agent for TechCorp. Be polite, concise, and solution-oriented.
My order #TC-8842 hasn't arrived yet. It was supposed to be delivered yesterday.

I apologize for the delay. Let me check the tracking for order #TC-8842. According to our system, it's currently out for delivery and should arrive by end of day today. Would you like me to send you the tracking link?

I want to return my laptop. It's been 25 days since purchase.
Our return policy allows returns within 30 days. Since it's been 25 days, you're still eligible. Please provide your order number and I'll initiate the return process with a prepaid shipping label.

The app keeps crashing when I try to upload photos.

Sorry about that issue. Could you tell me your device model and OS version? Also, try clearing the app cache: Settings > Apps > TechCorp > Storage > Clear Cache. If that doesn't work, we'll escalate to our engineering team.

How do I change my email address on my account?
Go to Account Settings > Profile > Edit Email. Enter your new email, verify via the link sent to that address, and you're done. Need help with the verification step?

I was charged twice for my subscription.

Yes! Upgrades take effect immediately and you'll be prorated for the remainder of your billing cycle. The new features will be available right away.

Check your spam/junk folder first. If not there, try requesting again — sometimes there's a slight delay. If still no email after 10 minutes, I can send a manual reset link.

How do I delete my account permanently?
Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Note: this is irreversible and all data will be purged within 30 days. You'll need to confirm via email.

Make sure your authenticator app's time is synced. If using SMS, check signal. You can also use backup codes from Account Settings > Security. Need me to disable 2FA temporarily?

Absolutely. Invoices are available in Account Settings > Billing > Invoices. You can download PDFs for any past transaction. Need a specific one re-sent?

Try re-enabling it: App Settings > Security > Biometric Login > toggle off/on. Also ensure your device OS and the app are updated to latest versions.
